bot_wipe:
🧹 *Deleted on our side.*
Your language and the step you were on are forgotten. We never had your number in clear, and nothing from this conversation is kept with us.

⚠️ *But this chat is on YOUR phone.* We have no way of deleting it remotely. Only you can do it, in 3 steps:

📱 *Android*
1. Go back to the chat list
2. Press and hold this chat
3. Tap 🗑️

📱 *iPhone*
1. Go back to the chat list
2. Swipe this chat to the left
3. Tap « More » then « Delete »

💡 *So that it clears itself next time:* open this chat, tap the name at the top, then « Disappearing messages » → *24 hours*. Everything we write will then disappear on its own.

_Write « Hello » whenever you want to come back._
